objective: Determine whether primary spin-foam sources closest to the Lorentzian EPRL/DVD setting provide an explicit graph/foam refinement or subdivision operation together with an amplitude-consistency/cylindrical-consistency rule that can authorize a later DVD boundary-refinement implementation.
positive_rule: A positive candidate must contain an explicit mathematical refinement/subdivision map or equivalence relation and an amplitude-invariance/consistency/composition statement under that operation. Merely allowing arbitrary graphs or mentioning a continuum limit is insufficient.
compatibility_rule: Even a positive source candidate only authorizes a later implementation if its operation can be applied to the two-4-link-dipole Lorentzian DVD boundary or to an explicitly equivalent EPRL boundary state without changing the physical semantic level.
claim_locks: DVD2 and DVD3 are fixed-boundary foams and are not to be relabelled coarse/fine.
Booster shell cutoff D is not graph refinement.
Euclidean-only normalization results cannot be silently promoted to Lorentzian EPRL.
BRIDGE_DERIVED remains false until a numerical held-out boundary-refinement amplitude gate passes.
